items.title: Jujutsu gets safer merge recovery
items.oneliner: jj 0.45 adds converge to auto-merge divergent commits and improves worktree handling for complex Git repos.

items.title: Coding agent tool choices benchmarked
items.oneliner: Study of 17,000 coding-agent runs shows which tools Claude, Codex, and Cursor actually install on real repos.

items.title: Postgres state transitions without race conditions
items.oneliner: Hands-on Postgres walkthrough shows how append-only status tables break under concurrency and how to fix them.

items.title: Jane Street ASIC reverse engineering walkthrough
items.oneliner: Detailed puzzle writeup uses Python gdstk to inspect GDS files and reverse engineer a custom chip.

items.title: ARM64 cache coherence debugging lesson
items.oneliner: Deep bare-metal debugging walkthrough explains why self-modifying ARM64 code failed without Icache and Dcache synchronization.

items.title: Haskell lazy evaluation explained practically
items.oneliner: Classic tutorial teaches lazy evaluation with concrete examples for infinite lists, strictness, and space-time reasoning.

items.title: Neovim async Lua for plugins
items.oneliner: Official vim.async docs show how to write cancellable non-blocking Lua tasks with await, timers, and checkpoints.

items.title: Force color through pipes reliably
items.oneliner: FORCE_COLOR standard lets CLI tools keep ANSI colors in logs, CI, and piped output without custom flags.

items.title: Parallel Minecraft server in Clojure
items.oneliner: Experimental server proves lock-free parallel ticks can match vanilla performance while keeping unrestricted world simulation.

items.title: Pedagogical IDE for language teaching
items.oneliner: Browser IDE lets students step through continuations, environments, and store state while running teaching-language programs.
